title: Remove bundle-derived counts from test docstrings and prose (opum-doc design ruling)
description: opum-doc design ruling (relayed via team-lead, 2026-10-10, from the LCLI-684 run): bundle-derived counts do not belong in test docstrings or prose. A test derives the count it asserts, and its docstring names what is counted, never the number. Filed because LCLI-684's own fixes kept updating hard-coded counts in test/lcli680-selection-zero-score-and-digest.test.ts (197->198->203 selected; 254->261 declared; 223->224->229) as each docs edit moved the bundle's eligible deck -- evidence that the number is not a stable thing to write down. Scope: remove such hard-coded bundle-derived counts across the repository's test docstrings and prose, replacing each with a statement of what is counted; where a test asserts a count, derive it at run time. Not campaign work.

acceptanceCriteria.text: No test docstring or prose passage in the repository states a hard-coded bundle-derived count; each names the quantity counted instead, and any test that asserts a count derives it at run time.
